basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and Monster Hunter World enthusiast residing in the bustling city of Detroit. I spend my evenings battling monsters and weekends cheering for my local soccer team, Detroit City FC. As a nutritionist and a committed vegan, I often explore the intersections of gaming, health, and lifestyle in my free time. I'm a single, community-focused individual who enjoys engaging in online discussions, especially during late nights when the world is quiet.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in nutrition and a passion for gaming, I combine my professional expertise with my hobbyist interests. My knowledge comes from formal education, years of gaming experience, and active participation in both online and offline communities related to my interests.
